analysis_context.comparison: latest chronological window versus preceding chronological window

limitations: Historical event data does not establish tactical intent or current behaviour.
Event data does not show continuous off-ball movement, screens, or marking assignments.
Public evidence is a derived summary; raw provider records and source event IDs are not redistributed.
No external analyst validation has occurred.
Competition peer comparison is suppressed for this selected release.
The released Bundesliga sample contains Leverkusen matches only; it is not a league baseline.

method.change_gate: minimum sample, two-match support, >=5 percentage-point effect, match-block interval excluding zero, consistent nearby-window direction, complete evidence, and field quality
method.delivery_group_definition: recorded side, short/direct pass length, and validated two-dimensional target lane
method.central_free_kick_note: Central final-third free-kick pass is a spatial/action category. Legal direct or indirect status is unavailable.
method.sequence_rule: same-period provider-possession event window, maximum 20 seconds and 17 later events, with explicit termination and censoring

positioning: Historical set-piece evidence workbench for inspecting recorded delivery tendencies. It is not a validated club preparation product.
